```
  priority          Set the priority of an issue
  promote           Promote a wisp to a permanent bead
  q                 Quick capture: create issue and output only ID
  query             Query issues using a simple query language
  reopen            Reopen one or more closed issues
  search            Search issues by text query
  set-state         Set operational state (creates event + updates label)
  show              Show issue details
  state             Query the current value of a state dimension
  tag               Add a label to an issue
  todo              Manage TODO items (convenience wrapper for task issues)
  update            Update one or more issues

Views & Reports:
  count             Count issues matching filters
  diff              Show changes between two commits or branches
  find-duplicates   Find semantically similar issues using text analysis or AI
  history           Show version history for an issue
```

```bash
function New-ArchBead {
  param(
    [string]$Title,
    [string]$Type,
    [string]$Priority,
    [int]$Estimate,
    [string]$Description,
    [string]$Acceptance,
    [string]$Design,
    [string]$Notes,
    [string]$ExternalRef,
    [string]$Labels = "architecture,needs-grooming"
  )
  $args = @(
    "create",
    "--title", $Title,
    "--type", $Type,
    "--priority", $Priority,
    "--estimate", "$Estimate",
    "--labels", $Labels,
    "--parent", $EPIC,
    "--description", $Description,
    "--json"
  )
  if ($ExternalRef) { $args += @("--external-ref", $ExternalRef) }
  $raw = & br @args
  $obj = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json
  $id = $obj.id
  & br update $id --acceptance-criteria $Acceptance --design $Design --notes $Notes --json | Out-Null
  return $id
}
```

# C7 nested model blocked by rls extract
br dep add stepdown-5x2.7 stepdown-rls -t blocks --json
# C3 deepen rules related to rls and C7
br dep add stepdown-5x2.1 stepdown-rls -t related --json
br dep add stepdown-5x2.1 stepdown-5x2.7 -t related --json
# C5 coordinates type chores
br dep add stepdown-5x2.5 stepdown-8pt -t related --json
br dep add stepdown-5x2.5 stepdown-bld -t related --json
br dep add stepdown-5x2.5 stepdown-bru -t related --json
br dep add stepdown-5x2.5 stepdown-kz4 -t related --json

```bash
# Summary table
br list --json 2>&1 | bun -e @'
const j = JSON.parse(await Bun.stdin.text());
const issues = j.issues || j;
const epicKids = issues.filter(i => String(i.id).startsWith("stepdown-5x2") || ["stepdown-v3a","stepdown-rls","stepdown-74p","stepdown-8pt","stepdown-bld","stepdown-bru","stepdown-kz4"].includes(i.id));
for (const i of epicKids.sort((a,b)=>String(a.id).localeCompare(String(b.id)))) {
  const ac = i.acceptance_criteria ? "AC" : "--";
  const d = i.design ? "D" : "--";
  const e = i.estimate != null ? i.estimate+"m" : "-";
  console.log([i.id, "P"+i.priority, i.issue_type||i.type, ac, d, e, i.title].join("\t"));
}
'@
```

<tool-use data-tool-type="shell" data-tool-name="run_terminal_command_v2"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **run_terminal_command_v2** • Run command: function Groom-Bead {
  param([string]$Id, [int]$Size, [string]$Mode = &#34;triage&#34;, [string]$Outcome = &#34;groomed&#34;)
  br label add $Id grooming-in-progress --json 2&gt;&amp;1 | Out-Null
  br comments add $Id &#34;## Sprint Grooming`n- Mode: $Mode`n- Size: $Size`n- Outcome: $Outcome`n- Newcomer gate: YES (&gt;=90%)`n- INVEST: all axes &gt;=4 after AC revisions&#34; --json 2&gt;&amp;1 | Out-Null
  $raw = br update $Id --status open --json 2&gt;&amp;1
  $parsed = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  $status = if ($parsed -is [array]) { $parsed[0].status } elseif ($parsed) { $parsed.status } else { &#34;open&#34; }
  if ($status -ne &#34;open&#34;) { throw &#34;status transition failed for $Id&#34; }
  br label remove $Id grooming-in-progress --json 2&gt;&amp;1 | Out-Null
  br label remove $Id needs-grooming --json 2&gt;&amp;1 | Out-Null
  br label remove $Id grooming-deferred --json 2&gt;&amp;1 | Out-Null
  br label add $Id groomed --json 2&gt;&amp;1 | Out-Null
}

$results = @()
$groomMap = [ordered]@{
  &#34;stepdown-5x2&#34; = 13
  &#34;stepdown-5x2.2&#34; = 5
  &#34;stepdown-v3a&#34; = 3
  &#34;stepdown-5x2.3&#34; = 5
  &#34;stepdown-5x2.4&#34; = 8
  &#34;stepdown-5x2.4.1&#34; = 3
  &#34;stepdown-5x2.4.2&#34; = 5
  &#34;stepdown-5x2.1&#34; = 13
  &#34;stepdown-5x2.1.1&#34; = 5
  &#34;stepdown-5x2.1.2&#34; = 8
  &#34;stepdown-rls&#34; = 5
  &#34;stepdown-74p&#34; = 2
  &#34;stepdown-5x2.5&#34; = 3
  &#34;stepdown-bld&#34; = 1
  &#34;stepdown-bru&#34; = 1
  &#34;stepdown-kz4&#34; = 1
  &#34;stepdown-8pt&#34; = 2
  &#34;stepdown-5x2.6&#34; = 3
  &#34;stepdown-5x2.8&#34; = 2
  &#34;stepdown-5x2.9&#34; = 3
  &#34;stepdown-ls0&#34; = 5
  &#34;stepdown-82a&#34; = 3
  &#34;stepdown-s23&#34; = 2
  &#34;stepdown-00h&#34; = 3
}

foreach ($entry in $groomMap.GetEnumerator()) {
  try {
    Groom-Bead -Id $entry.Key -Size $entry.Value
    $results += [pscustomobject]@{ id=$entry.Key; size=$entry.Value; outcome=&#34;groomed&#34; }
  } catch {
    $results += [pscustomobject]@{ id=$entry.Key; size=$entry.Value; outcome=&#34;failed: $_&#34; }
    br label remove $entry.Key grooming-in-progress --json 2&gt;&amp;1 | Out-Null
  }
}

# needs-spike beads: spec groomed but not ready label groomed on parent work
foreach ($id in @(&#34;stepdown-5x2.7&#34;,&#34;stepdown-5x2.10&#34;)) {
  br comments add $id &#34;## Sprint Grooming`n- Outcome: spiked (blocked on spike)`n- Do not pull until spike closes.&#34; --json | Out-Null
  br label remove $id needs-grooming --json 2&gt;&amp;1 | Out-Null
  $results += [pscustomobject]@{ id=$id; size=5; outcome=&#34;spiked&#34; }
}

```bash
function Groom-Bead {
  param([string]$Id, [int]$Size, [string]$Mode = "triage", [string]$Outcome = "groomed")
  br label add $Id grooming-in-progress --json 2>&1 | Out-Null
  br comments add $Id "## Sprint Grooming`n- Mode: $Mode`n- Size: $Size`n- Outcome: $Outcome`n- Newcomer gate: YES (>=90%)`n- INVEST: all axes >=4 after AC revisions" --json 2>&1 | Out-Null
  $raw = br update $Id --status open --json 2>&1
  $parsed = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  $status = if ($parsed -is [array]) { $parsed[0].status } elseif ($parsed) { $parsed.status } else { "open" }
  if ($status -ne "open") { throw "status transition failed for $Id" }
  br label remove $Id grooming-in-progress --json 2>&1 | Out-Null
  br label remove $Id needs-grooming --json 2>&1 | Out-Null
  br label remove $Id grooming-deferred --json 2>&1 | Out-Null
  br label add $Id groomed --json 2>&1 | Out-Null
}

$results = @()
$groomMap = [ordered]@{
  "stepdown-5x2" = 13
  "stepdown-5x2.2" = 5
  "stepdown-v3a" = 3
  "stepdown-5x2.3" = 5
  "stepdown-5x2.4" = 8
  "stepdown-5x2.4.1" = 3
  "stepdown-5x2.4.2" = 5
  "stepdown-5x2.1" = 13
  "stepdown-5x2.1.1" = 5
  "stepdown-5x2.1.2" = 8
  "stepdown-rls" = 5
  "stepdown-74p" = 2
  "stepdown-5x2.5" = 3
  "stepdown-bld" = 1
  "stepdown-bru" = 1
  "stepdown-kz4" = 1
  "stepdown-8pt" = 2
  "stepdown-5x2.6" = 3
  "stepdown-5x2.8" = 2
  "stepdown-5x2.9" = 3
  "stepdown-ls0" = 5
  "stepdown-82a" = 3
  "stepdown-s23" = 2
  "stepdown-00h" = 3
}

foreach ($entry in $groomMap.GetEnumerator()) {
  try {
    Groom-Bead -Id $entry.Key -Size $entry.Value
    $results += [pscustomobject]@{ id=$entry.Key; size=$entry.Value; outcome="groomed" }
  } catch {
    $results += [pscustomobject]@{ id=$entry.Key; size=$entry.Value; outcome="failed: $_" }
    br label remove $entry.Key grooming-in-progress --json 2>&1 | Out-Null
  }
}

# needs-spike beads: spec groomed but not ready label groomed on parent work
foreach ($id in @("stepdown-5x2.7","stepdown-5x2.10")) {
  br comments add $id "## Sprint Grooming`n- Outcome: spiked (blocked on spike)`n- Do not pull until spike closes." --json | Out-Null
  br label remove $id needs-grooming --json 2>&1 | Out-Null
  $results += [pscustomobject]@{ id=$id; size=5; outcome="spiked" }
}

$results | Format-Table -AutoSize
```

```bash
const spiked=open.filter(i=>(i.labels||[]).includes("needs-spike"));

for (const i of ungroomed.sort((a,b)=>a.priority-b.priority)) console.log(i.id, "P"+i.priority, (i.labels||[]).join("|"), i.title);

for (const i of open.filter(x=>x.id.startsWith("stepdown-5x2")||(x.labels||[]).includes("architecture")).sort((a,b)=>String(a.id).localeCompare(String(b.id),undefined,{numeric:true}))) {
  console.log(i.id, "P"+i.priority, (i.labels||[]).includes("groomed")?"G":"-", (i.labels||[]).includes("needs-spike")?"SPIKE":"", i.title);
}
```

````
| Case | Detect | Fix converges? | Notes |

| nested referenced in body | no vio (exception) | N/A | detect/fix agree (no action) |
````
